problem:
Let $⟨x,-2⟩$ be the solution of the system of equations below. 

$$
{\begin{aligned}15x+8y=-1 \\ kx+13y=-31.\end{aligned}
$$

Which of the following equations could be solved to find the value of $k?$

- $|\begin{aligned}15 & 8 \\ k & 13\end{aligned}|=2|\begin{aligned}15 & -1 \\ k & -31\end{aligned}|$
- $|\begin{aligned}15 & 8 \\ k & 13\end{aligned}|=-4|\begin{aligned}15 & -1 \\ k & -31\end{aligned}|$
- $-2|\begin{aligned}15 & 8 \\ k & 13\end{aligned}|=|\begin{aligned}15 & -1 \\ k & -31\end{aligned}|$
